metadata.title: Cyan Duotone Portrait with Expressive Script

recipe.visualDefinition: A monochromatic cyan-toned composition featuring a mirrored or duplicated male subject in western attire, overlaid with bold, gestural hand-written script that spans the width of the frame.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical duplication of the central figure creating a rhythmic pattern.
High-contrast black and white lettering against a mid-tone cyan background.
Textured, gritty background contrasting with the clean lines of the subject's silhouette.
Layering of text directly over the subject's torso to integrate typography with imagery.
coreInvariants: Gritty, film-grain texture across the entire image.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two identical figures placed side-by-side, occupying the left and right thirds of the frame, scaled from waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, bold script lettering positioned horizontally across the center of the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central dark text, move outward to the mirrored faces, then down the vertical lines of the subjects' bodies.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the background is a textured wall that feels dense due to the duotone treatment.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cyan/Teal (Mid-tone base for the entire image).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the cyan channel with crushed blacks and blown-out highlights to create a graphic, posterized effect.
paletteRestrictions: Strictly monochromatic cyan/teal scale plus black and white.

letterConstructionRules: Variable stroke width mimicking a flat-nib marker or brush.
Extremely long, horizontal flourishes on terminal characters.
Connected, fluid lowercase letters with sharp, aggressive angles.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Ascenders and descenders are minimized to keep the text block compact.
Horizontal crossbars extend significantly beyond the letter boundaries.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a heavy black script and a lighter, thinner white script for depth.
graphicDevices: Horizontal dividing line in the background texture.

preserve: The horizontal extension of the script

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the gestural, hand-drawn energy of the original.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A man in a western shirt and jeans holding a guitar, duplicated side-by-side against a textured wall. Apply a heavy cyan duotone filter with high contrast and film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, expressive hand-written script in black for the top line and white for the bottom line, centered over the subject's chest area with long horizontal flourishes.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly cyan, black, and white?
Are there two identical subjects mirrored or repeated?
Does the text have long, horizontal gestural tails?
Is the overall texture gritty and film-like?

adjustableVariables: Cyan hue shift (towards teal or true blue)
Subject pose (as long as it remains western-themed)
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Any brand logos on the clothing or guitar
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible despite the expressive style.
Check that the duotone doesn't lose all detail in the shadows.
Verify the grain is uniform across both the subject and background.
recipe.reuseFormula: Duplicated Subject + Cyan Duotone + High Contrast + Gestural Script Overlay = Gritty Western Aesthetic.
